'''Ambre Junsen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|Female]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She was part of the Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]], where she served as a supply officer specializing in armor modifications.
